original_goal:
[Module: Product Detail | TC-005 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Add to cart is unavailable when product is already InCart (Negative | High)

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "initial_product_state": "InCart"
}

Preconditions:
  Product is already InCart; user is on the Product Detail page for that product (Remove button visible).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Open the Product Detail page for a product whose state is InCart
  2. Look for an Add to cart button on the page
  3. If visible, attempt to click it

Expected Result:
  The Add to cart button is not visible or is disabled; the page shows the Remove action instead; product remains InCart and no additional item is added.

Notes from prior verification:
  Verification confirmed the page shows Remove and the Add to cart button is absent, so the conditional click is not executed as intended.
expected_outcome: The Add to cart button is not visible or is disabled; the page shows the Remove action instead; product remains InCart and no additional item is added.
